phrase.zh: 把消息拆开，仍能送到一起。
phrase.en: Split a message, then bring it together.

visual.zh: 小块数据穿行于交错的线路和节点之间，表现网络不依赖一根专用长线。线路是艺术示意，不是实际网络拓扑。
visual.en: Small blocks travel between crossing lines and nodes, suggesting communication without one dedicated end-to-end wire. The links are not a real network topology.

background.zh: 分组交换将数据拆成较小的“包”送过共享网络。计算机历史博物馆记载，巴兰与戴维斯等人在 20 世纪 60 年代独立提出相关方案；ARPANET 后来采用了分组交换技术。
background.en: Packet switching divides data into smaller packets for a shared network. The Computer History Museum describes independent proposals by Baran, Davies and others in the 1960s; ARPANET later used packet-switching techniques.
